test_objective: Check that you can create a context source registration with specific ID and expiration date

test_cases.name: 033_01_01 Create Context Source Registration With Specific Date Expiration Date
test_cases.doc: Check that you can create a context source registration with specific ID and expiration date
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/csourceRegistrations'
        method set to 'POST'
        Request Header['Content-Type'] set to 'application/ld+json' and
 payload defined in file: '${registration_payload}'
}
